selection_reason: This is the largest fixed BirdSet SSW partition that excludes all recordings used by the nested grouped 5/10/20-shot support sets.

sample_specification.partition_rule: Seed-42 grouped 20-shot support recordings are excluded. The nested 5-shot and 10-shot supports are therefore excluded too.
sample_specification.known_limitation: Setophaga_ruticilla has only two target clips in the complete filtered SSW set; both belong to an excluded support recording, so this held-out partition has no positive clip for that class.
